items.text: Seattle QB (uncertain): Sam Darnold (ribs/quad) practiced Monday for the first time in three weeks; Macdonald plans for him to start but 'we'll see how Wednesday goes.' Drew Lock starts if not.
Seattle (early week): not practicing Mon - LG Quenton Nelson (knee), RT Abraham Lucas (ankle), RG Anthony Bradford. Back on field - LT Charles Cross, DL Leonard Williams. IR - RB George Holani.

San Francisco (early week): RT Colton McKivitz (ankle fracture/dislocation) out for season, Vederian Lowe starts; CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) left Wk11, uncertain. IR - WRs Ricky Pearsall, Christian Kirk. Brock Purdy starts.
